title: Operations: rotas, clock in and out, timesheets, tasks, forms and checklists
summary: Day-to-day work now runs in the intranet. See your shifts, swap or pick up shifts, clock in with a tap, send in your timesheet, and keep on top of tasks, forms and daily checklists.

added: Rota: see your published shifts, tell rota builders when you cannot work, claim open shifts and ask to swap a shift with a colleague. A manager approves each change, and everyone involved gets an email.

For supervisors and management: shift templates by site and role, a weekly rota you can build from them, clash warnings when someone is unavailable or double-booked, and one click to publish and email the team.
Clock in and out with a tap on the intranet or the installed app, including breaks. The app has a Clock in and out shortcut. Managers are told about a missed clock-out and can record the time.
Weekly timesheets built from your clock records. Managers approve them, which locks them, or return them with a note. Management and HR can see and download volunteer hours totals.
Tasks for a person, a team or a shift, with due dates, repeats and comments. Overdue tasks show on your dashboard. Team projects stay in Microsoft Planner.
Forms: fill in APES forms, including photos and a signature, and they go straight to the right person or team. Admins build and publish forms in the Admin panel and can download the answers.
Daily checklists for animal care and sites, attached to each shift, with notes and photos. Managers are told when a checklist is missed, and completed checklists can no longer be changed.
Your dashboard now shows your next shift, checklists due today and overdue tasks.
security: Photos and signatures from forms and checklists are kept privately and only shown to the people who need them.

The optional location check at clock-in is off. If APES switches it on for a site, it only records whether you were near the site when you tapped Clock in, never where you were, and you are always clocked in.
accessibility: Wide tables can be scrolled with the keyboard on small screens, and the rich text editor is now announced properly by screen readers.
You can type your name instead of drawing a signature.

internal_notes: The geofence needs both the DPIA approval date (approved 10 November 2026) and the switch set in the app's environment, plus a geofence area on each site. Neither is set by this release.

Developer changes in this release: AGENTS.md uses full milestone versions, Operations permissions are re-seeded on every deploy, Larastan reads the module migrations and model casts, and the accessibility check covers the Operations pages.
